`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or any tests.

The 404 uses `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)` from `src/api/errors.py`. That follows the project's problem+json convention for API errors. Previously a missing invoice made the handler fail on `None.__dict__`.

I added the import as `from .errors import problem`. Nothing else in `src` imports from `errors` yet, so I had no existing import style to copy.
